user.title: IPP printer
user.description: Connect to a network printer via IPP.

data_description.port: 443 for IPPS, 631 for IPP, 80 for plain HTTP.
data_description.use_tls: On for IPPS/HTTPS printers, off for plain IPP.
data_description.user: Sent as the IPP requesting-user-name. `anonymous` works for most printers.
data_description.password: Only if the printer requires HTTP basic auth.
data_description.verify_tls: Leave off for self-signed certificates (most consumer printers).
data_description.relaxed_ciphers: Enable if the log shows SSLV3_ALERT_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE (some HP LaserJets only offer non-PFS ciphers).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered IPP printer
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add **{name}** at {host} to Home Assistant? Uses anonymous IPP without certificate verification; adjust later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer. Check host/port/path/TLS settings. Detail: {error_detail}

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this printer is already in progress.

print_file.name: Print file
print_file.description: Send a file on the Home Assistant host to the printer. The path must be under www/, a media directory, or allowlist_external_dirs.

path.name: Path
path.description: Absolute path of the file on the Home Assistant host.

document_format.name: Document format
document_format.description: MIME type to send. Detected from content (PDF, JPEG, PNG) when omitted; set application/octet-stream to let the printer auto-sense.

job_name.name: Job name
job_name.description: Name shown on the printer and in the job sensor. Defaults to the file name.

sides.name: Sides
sides.description: Simplex or duplex, if the printer supports it.
